tasks.task: Open the Score Improvement Estimator, type 820 as the current score, and type 3 into the collections field, leaving late payments and hard inquiries at 0.
tasks.expected: The projected score displays as 850 (Excellent) — capped at the maximum — not 895.

tasks.expected: The projection updates by itself as values are typed: the current score is shown as 545 (Poor) and the projected score as 595 (Fair).

tasks.task: On the Score Improvement Estimator, enter 600 as the current score, 1 collection, and 1 late payment.
tasks.expected: The projected score reads 640 (Fair) and the recommended plan is Standard — the 40-point gain falls in the 40-75 range, not in Basic.

tasks.task: Submit a credit score inquiry entering 640 as the current score along with any other required details, then click the 'project my improvement' option it offers.
tasks.expected: The Score Improvement Estimator opens with 640 already filled in as the current score, displayed as 640 (Fair).

tasks.task: Start the enrollment flow, pick the Standard plan, add the credit monitoring add-on, enter name 'Dana Cole' and email 'dana@mail.com' in the contact step, and continue to the review step.
tasks.expected: The review shows a monthly total of $99.98 and a first payment of $124.98, which includes the $25.00 one-time setup fee.

tasks.task: Go through the enrollment flow choosing Premium with the rush processing add-on, enter name 'Dana Cole' and email 'dana@mail.com', and reach the review step.
tasks.expected: The monthly total shows $149.98 and the first payment also equals $149.98 — no $25.00 setup fee is added because Premium waives it.

tasks.task: In the enrollment contact step, enter name 'Bo' and email 'bo@' and try to continue, then correct the email to 'bo@mail.com' and continue again.
tasks.expected: The invalid email blocks progression with a validation error, and after the correction the review step is reachable.

tasks.task: On the Score Improvement Estimator, enter current score 600, 1 collection, and 1 late payment, then use the enroll option on its plan recommendation.
tasks.expected: The enrollment flow opens with the Standard plan already selected, matching the estimator's recommendation for the 40-point gain.

tasks.task: On the Client Success Stories page, filter to the Premium plan only.
tasks.expected: Only Sofia, Marcus, and Priya remain visible, and the average gain updates to +87.7 pts.

tasks.task: Open the Dispute Strategy Advisor page, count the creditor cards, and check which card sits on top.
tasks.expected: Exactly 4 creditor cards appear — Midland Funding's two cases roll into one card, not 5 per-case cards — and Midland Funding sits first with a 'multi-bureau' tag and a priority of 7 (2 points each for its two unresolved cases plus the 3-point multi-bureau bonus), not 4.

tasks.task: On the Dispute Strategy Advisor, check the order and priority scores of the cards below Midland Funding.
tasks.expected: LVNV Funding and Portfolio Recovery both show priority 2, with LVNV Funding listed first on the alphabetical tie-break, and First Premier Bank sits last at priority 0.

tasks.task: On the Dispute Strategy Advisor, read the next-move line on the Midland Funding, LVNV Funding, and First Premier Bank cards.
tasks.expected: Midland Funding says 'Send the pending letter' — its Equifax case is still a Draft even though its TransUnion case was Sent — LVNV Funding says 'Await the bureau's response', and First Premier Bank says 'Request an updated credit report'.

tasks.task: In the dispute tracker, move the Portfolio Recovery case from Draft to Sent, then open the Dispute Strategy Advisor page.
tasks.expected: Portfolio Recovery's card now reads 'Await the bureau's response' instead of 'Send the pending letter', its priority stays 2, and it still sits after LVNV Funding.
